direct_answer: Useful community metrics measure meaningful participation rather than raw activity. Depending on the model, track activation, repeat participation, contributor concentration, response quality, time to first value, retention, event or program participation, member-to-member interaction, and outcomes tied to the community purpose.
best_for: brands and companies building or operating owned communities
teams that need strategy and operating ownership to connect
not_for: teams seeking guaranteed member growth or revenue
organizations unwilling to define member value or operating ownership
